visual_action: A person drives a horse-drawn, two-wheeled sulky down a paved road in a rural setting with power lines and bare trees, under an overcast sky. The camera pans to follow them.

cast.name: unnamed person
cast.evidence: A person is shown from a distance driving a horse-drawn sulky.

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: As a post from the @democrats account, the criticism of a negative economic condition (high gas prices) is implicitly directed at their main political opposition.

on_screen_text.text: new ride with these gas prices 😭😥

spoken_summary: The video's audio consists of lyrics from the song "Old Town Road (Remix)": "Can't nobody tell me nothing... I'm gonna take my horse to the old town road, I'm gonna ride 'til I can't no more."
audio_music: The entire video is set to the upbeat, popular country-trap song "Old Town Road (Remix)" by Lil Nas X ft. Billy Ray Cyrus. The lyrics about riding a horse directly and humorously complement the visuals.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous shot that pans to follow the action.
cultural_references: The song 'Old Town Road (Remix)' by Lil Nas X and Billy Ray Cyrus is used as the soundtrack.
The video uses a common meme format of showing an old-fashioned mode of transport as a reaction to high gas prices.
central_claim: Gas prices are so prohibitively high that people are being forced to resort to old-fashioned transportation like horse-drawn buggies.
intended_effect: To create a humorous and relatable sense of frustration about high gas prices and to associate that frustration with the political opposition.
